notice: Season-specific team affiliations. Each entry is backed by an NCAA Directory page plus an official conference or institutional page, retrieved and hashed on the date shown. Raw copies are kept locally in data/raw/affiliations/ (git-ignored). Division is never inferred from a scoreboard filter or a URL parameter. "division" is the sport-specific division from the NCAA Directory sport row (written to the CSV); institution_division/institution_status/reclass_division record the institution's membership separately.
